title: Dye Casting Recipes (Hex Casting x Dye Depot Compat)
description: A data pack that adds compatibility between Dye Depot and Hex Casting.
body:
This is a data pack that adds compatibility between Hex Casting and Dye Depot. This means that Dye Depot's pigments can now be craftable in Survival mode.

This is meant to go with [Dye Casting](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dye-casting), its companion resource pack.
